lines.1: On the way home after the teachers finished chewing me out.
lines.3: Subaru had disappeared at some point.
lines.5: 「Yes. What you did was way too much! You could have handled it a little more calmly.」
lines.6: 「Give me a break. The teachers already gave me an earful.」
lines.7: 「Ah... N-no, that isn't what I meant.」
lines.12: For some reason, I braced myself.
lines.19: 「Aren't you going to scold me for breaking school rules?」
lines.20: 「O-of course I have plenty to say about that.」
lines.21: 「But more than that... How do I put it... That.」
lines.27: 「You were talking pretty tough back there.」
lines.28: 「Of course! Like I'd ever give in to people like them!」
lines.29: 「But if you hadn't come, I probably would have gotten hurt.」
lines.31: 「And... when you came to help me...」
lines.34: 「Ahaha... N-no, I can't. This is embarrassing. Really embarrassing!」
lines.35: She turned bright red in an instant.
lines.37: She took off like a startled rabbit.
lines.39: She looked back at me with some strange embarrassed smile.
lines.43: I felt like running away too.
